label: D1 after a reward, when the agent is about to choose a2, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), only when the reward input is 1, and essentially only when the agent goes on to choose a2 (42157/42161 active steps have action 2; at D1 this is the upcoming choice, which the agent computes, so it is not a future-information cheat; prev_action==2 or unknown is nearly equivalent, F1 0.69). Active steps fall in the D1 policy-logit bin -4.44..-1.52 (a mild a2 preference) and the value <7.5 bins. Strongly episode-time dependent: nothing before ep trial 10, rising sharply after trial 60 (98% of mass in trials 50-99), and much more when S2 is the hidden good state. Magnitude is largest on the first reward after an unrewarded trial and decays over consecutive rewarded trials (1.0 -> 0.75 -> 0.7). Never fires after no reward, on a1 choices, or at GO/D2. Recorded predicate: dev F1 0.76, mass recall 0.95; adding good != 1 gives F1 0.78; the choice-logit/value band reaches 0.79 but is a model readout. False positives are mostly runs of consecutive rewards where it decays below threshold, and early-episode trials.
